sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Market breadth remains narrow with only 2 of 11 sectors all-green, anchored by Technology's dominant momentum while cyclical and defensive laggards struggle.

Technology continues to lead the market with exceptional strength, standing as the only sustained leader across medium- and long-term horizons alongside Energy. Meanwhile, rotation remains muted across the broader market, with minimal rank changes over the past five sessions. 

Utilities and consumer-facing sectors are fading toward the bottom of the momentum curve. Real Estate edged up slightly in the near term despite muted absolute momentum, while Financials slipped further into the bottom half of sector rankings.

## Strength
- Technology is the undisputed leader, posting a 0.950 momentum score (rank_ytd 2) and sustained top-3 status across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons.
- Narrow breadth persists, with only 2 of 11 sectors qualifying as all-green: Technology (0.95 momentum) and Communication Services (0.53 momentum).
- Energy remains resilient at rank_ytd 1, sharing the second-highest momentum score of 0.683 with Healthcare (rank_ytd 5).

## Movers & Momentum
- Real Estate was the sole rank gainer over the last 5 sessions, moving up +1 spot to rank 7 with a 0.28 momentum score.
- Financial was the lone rank decliner, dropping -1 spot to rank 8 with a 0.45 momentum score.
- Basic Materials (0.600 momentum, rank_ytd 3) and Industrials (0.550 momentum, rank_ytd 4) round out the upper-tier momentum leaders.
- Utilities sits at the bottom of the momentum spectrum at 0.067 (rank_ytd 10), closely trailed by Real Estate (0.283) and Consumer Cyclical (0.317, rank_ytd 11).

## Divergences
- Communication Services maintains an all-green profile across all timeframes despite a low 5-session rank of 9 and moderate momentum of 0.53.
- Real Estate improved +1 spot in short-term rank to 7, yet remains mired in deep momentum laggard territory at 0.283.
- No sectors are currently flagged with fragile all-green status.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Broad market breadth remains narrow with only 9 of 144 groups all-green, heavily anchored by dominant tech hardware and semiconductor momentum while consumer cyclicals stage early short-term rebounds.

Technology hardware and supply chain plays continue to drive market leadership, with Electronics & Computer Distribution, Computer Hardware, and Semiconductors all holding momentum scores above 0.92. At the same time, short-term rotation is favoring beaten-down travel and retail pockets—led by Airlines (+18 spots) and Apparel Retail (+15 spots)—even as their broader momentum metrics lag.

Conversely, defensive and yield-sensitive spaces are fading quickly. Publishing (-22 spots), Insurance - Property & Casualty (-13 spots), and Utilities - Regulated Electric (-9 spots) suffered notable five-session drops, while Mortgage Finance (0.035) and Gambling (0.054) anchor the bottom of the momentum rankings.

## Strength
- **All-Green Technology Dominance:** Only 9 of 144 industry groups are positive across week, month, quarter, half, and YTD frames, led by Electronics & Computer Distribution (0.962 momentum, rank 3 YTD), Computer Hardware (0.936 momentum, rank 1 YTD), and Semiconductors (0.927 momentum, rank 7 YTD).
- **Sustained Multimonth Leaders:** Groups demonstrating sustained relative strength (top 36 across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons) include Diagnostics & Research (0.887 momentum), Consumer Electronics (0.86 momentum), Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing, and Software - Infrastructure (0.80 momentum).
- **Materials Standout:** Copper remains near peak momentum with a 0.864 score, sitting at rank 9 YTD.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Top Rank Gainers:** Airlines posted the largest five-session gain, climbing +18 spots to rank 91 (0.58 momentum), followed by Apparel Retail (+15 spots to rank 110) and Industrial Distribution (+12 spots to rank 47).
- **Sharp Decliners:** Publishing dropped -22 spots over 5 sessions to rank 67 (0.37 momentum), while Telecom Services fell -13 spots to rank 92 (0.29 momentum) and Aluminum slid -10 spots to rank 96 (0.29 momentum).
- **Momentum Troughs:** Severe laggards remain suppressed at the bottom of the market, including Mortgage Finance (0.035 momentum, rank 142 YTD), Gambling (0.054 momentum, rank 143 YTD), and Personal Services (0.100 momentum, rank 138 YTD).

## Divergences
- **Fading Financials & Energy:** Despite healthy momentum, short-term ranks are slipping for Financial Conglomerates (momentum 0.80, rank -3 in 5d), Insurance - Life (momentum 0.68, rank -6 in 5d), Banks - Diversified (momentum 0.66, rank -4 in 5d), and Oil & Gas Equipment & Services (momentum 0.66, rank -3 in 5d).
- **Emerging Low-Momentum Turnarounds:** Apparel Retail (+15 spots in 5d, 0.41 momentum) and Specialty Retail (+10 spots in 5d, 0.41 momentum) are posting aggressive short-term rank jumps despite weak overall momentum profiles.
- **Real Estate Contrast:** Real Estate - Diversified is jumping near-term (+11 spots in 5d to 0.52 momentum), while REIT - Healthcare Facilities is losing ground (momentum 0.63, rank -4 in 5d).
